itens.trecho: Transformers é um filme que entretém e satisfaz Transformers consegue se sustentar, Michael Bay consegue criar boas sequências de ação e traz uma experiência divertida e nostálgica.

With all the gazillion planets in the galaxy to choose from, the warring Cybertron races of "Autobots" (the sort of goodies) and "Decepticons" (the sort of baddies) descend on Earth in search of a missing cube.

Car fetishism, good vs evil, alien (illegal of course) emigrants wrecking havoc, military might, some conspiracy theories for perspective, and male bravery that saves the day. Much action, next to nothing in substance. Skip it, unless you are a teenager.
